support.faq1a: Delivery times range from 2 to 5 business days depending on your location. You will receive a tracking number as soon as your order is shipped.
support.faq2q: How can I return a product?
support.faq2a: You have 14 days after receipt to return an unopened product. Contact our support to get a return label.
support.faq3q: Are the products tested on animals?
support.faq3a: Absolutely not. All our products are Cruelty-Free certified and we prioritize ingredients of natural and ethical origin.
support.faq4q: Can I modify my order after validation?
support.faq4a: Once validated, an order is quickly prepared. If it has not yet been shipped, we can try to modify it. Contact us as soon as possible.
support.faq5q: What payment methods do you accept?
support.faq5a: We accept credit cards (Visa, Mastercard, AMEX), PayPal and Apple Pay.
support.delivery3: Shipped within 24 h for orders before noon
support.returns2: Intact products and original packaging required
support.terms1: These terms and conditions govern all relationships between DAWSM and its customers. Any order on the site implies full acceptance of these conditions.
support.terms2: Our products are described with the greatest accuracy. Prices are all-inclusive in euros. DAWSM reserves the right to modify its prices but applies the rate at the time of the order.
support.terms3: Payment is made via secure gateways (Stripe, PayPal). No banking data is stored on our servers.
support.privacy1: We only collect the information necessary to process your orders and personalize your diagnostic. Your data is never sold.
support.privacy2: You have the right to access, correct, and delete your personal data at any time through your customer account or by email.
